intro:
Train your math thinking with 4-choice quizzes!
Read, observe, and solve number and shape problems
Quick to play alone or together with family
description:
Enjoy elementary-level math through simple 4-choice quiz stages.

Read each question carefully, check the illustrations and conditions, then choose the correct answer from four options. The quizzes include word problems, number rules, counting, calculations, and shape-based questions that test flexible thinking.

How to play:
・Read the question
・Look at the picture and clues
・Choose one answer from four options

The simple format makes it easy to start, even for short play sessions. Kids can use it for light math review, while adults can enjoy it as a quick brain-training challenge. It is also a good fit for parents and children to discuss the answer together.

Recommended for:
・Players who enjoy math quizzes
・Kids reviewing elementary-level math
・Families looking for a simple thinking game
・Anyone who wants short brain-training puzzles

Read carefully, think it through, and find the right answer!
